categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches `src/net_processing.cpp` to optimize peer message handling and carries the P2P label.
categories.rationale: Eliminating unconditional `cs_main` acquisition in `ProcessOrphanTx` prevents peer message processing from blocking whenever validation, RPC, or wallet threads hold the lock. Microbenchmarks showed ping handling latency dropping from 50.1 ms to 0.02 ms during concurrent lock contention.
